Explanation: Consolidated provincial CALABARZON food-insecurity and food-poverty estimates from official published sources.
These are sparse survey / poverty-statistics observations, not quarterly provincial labels.
HFIAS food-security categories; provincial sheet reports food-secure and severely food-insecure estimates plus sample size and precision.
Provincial values are reproduced in DEPDev CALABARZON RDP Midterm Update; each province has its own reference year.
Subsistence incidence measures income below the food threshold. It is a food-poverty indicator, not an experience-based household food-insecurity measure.
Annual per-capita thresholds are in a separate sheet from incidence. Do not confuse them with monthly family-of-five thresholds.
Use as historical context / external validation only where the target definition, geography, and reference period match. Do not synthesize or interpolate missing quarters.
Long-format labelled records for FNRI 2015, ENNS provincial estimates, and PSA subsistence incidence. Label types and ML-use restrictions are explicit.

Labels are published aggregate indicator observations, not household-level class labels and not quarterly training rows. Do not create binary HIGH/LOW labels from these percentages without a separately justified, validated rule.
